items.verse: وَمَا مِنْ غَآئِبَةٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
items.verseEn: And there is nothing concealed within the heaven and the earth except that it is in a clear Register.

items.verse: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَعْبُدُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ حَرْفٍۢ ۖ فَإِنْ أَصَابَهُۥ خَيْرٌ ٱطْمَأَنَّ بِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ فِتْنَةٌ ٱنقَلَبَ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ خَسِرَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
items.verseEn: And of the people is he who worships Allāh on an edge. If he is touched by good, he is reassured by it; but if he is struck by trial, he turns on his face [to unbelief]. He has lost [this] world and the Hereafter. That is what is the manifest loss.

items.verse: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا مُبْصِرَةًۭ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
items.verseEn: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."

items.verse: ۞ قُلْ مَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَإِنَّآ أَوْ إِيَّاكُمْ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى أَوْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
items.verseEn: Say, "Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?" Say, "Allāh. And indeed, we or you are either upon guidance or in clear error."

categories.name: أَسْمَاءٌ عَلَى وَزْنِ فِعْلَةٍ
categories.nameEn: Quranic nouns on the pattern fi'lah

items.verse: وَٱذْكُرْنَ مَا يُتْلَىٰ فِى بُيُوتِكُنَّ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْحِكْمَةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ لَطِيفًا خَبِيرًا
items.verseEn: And remember what is recited in your houses of the verses of Allāh and wisdom. Indeed, Allāh is ever Subtle and Aware.

items.verse: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ هَمَّ قَوْمٌ أَن يَبْسُطُوٓا۟ إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ فَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
items.verseEn: O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allāh upon you when a people determined to extend their hands [in aggression] against you, but He withheld their hands from you; and fear Allāh. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.

items.verse: وَمَن يَرْغَبُ عَن مِّلَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمَ إِلَّا مَن سَفِهَ نَفْسَهُۥ ۚ وَلَقَدِ ٱصْطَفَيْنَـٰهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
items.verseEn: And who would be averse to the religion of Abraham except one who makes a fool of himself. And We had chosen him in this world, and indeed he, in the Hereafter, will be among the righteous.

items.verse: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍۢ وَشِقَاقٍۢ
items.verseEn: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.

categories.name: أَفْعَالُ الْمُكَذِّبِ فِي سُورَةِ الْمُدَّثِّرِ
categories.nameEn: Actions of the Denier in Surah Al-Muddathir

items.verseEn: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
Then he turned back and was arrogant

categories.name: أَلْفَاظُ التَّنْبِيهِ وَالْإِجَابَةِ وَالرَّدْعِ
categories.nameEn: Expressions of Attention, Affirmation, and Rebuke in the Quran

items.verse: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْسِدُونَ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
items.verseEn: Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive [it] not.

items.verse: بَلَىٰ مَن كَسَبَ سَيِّئَةًۭ وَأَحَـٰطَتْ بِهِۦ خَطِيٓـَٔتُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
items.verseEn: Yes, [on the contrary], whoever earns evil and his sin has encompassed him - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

items.verse: وَٱلَّذِى قَالَ لِوَٰلِدَيْهِ أُفٍّۢ لَّكُمَآ أَتَعِدَانِنِىٓ أَنْ أُخْرَجَ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ ٱلْقُرُونُ مِن قَبْلِى وَهُمَا يَسْتَغِيثَانِ ٱللَّهَ وَيْلَكَ ءَامِنْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
items.verseEn: But one who says to his parents, "Uff to you; do you promise me that I will be brought forth [from the earth] when generations before me have already passed on [into oblivion]?" while they call to Allāh for help [and to their son], "Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth." But he says, "This is not but legends of the former peoples" -

harf.hint: A solemn promise one makes with the Divine
harf.arabicVerse: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًۭا
harf.verse: 19:87 - None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.

deduction.title: The Call from the Sacred Valley
deduction.intro: Beyond the pages of history lies the story of a soul who stood between a powerful ruler and an entire enslaved people. This individual was called upon to deliver a nation from tyranny, performing wonders that defied every natural law. From a sacred mount to a miracle upon the waters, this servant of Allah witnessed signs that would echo through the ages. Your task today is to identify this remarkable figure whose legacy shaped the course of human history.
clues: I was born during a time when my people faced a deadly decree, and my family placed me in the waters to save my life.
I was found and raised in the very household of the ruler who had ordered the deaths of my kind.
I fled to a sacred mount where I saw fire upon a tree that was not consumed, and a voice spoke to me from it.
I was sent back to that very ruler with miracles, demanding the freedom of my enslaved people.
I struck the sea with my staff, and it parted into dry paths, swallowing the pursuers who followed my people.
I communed with my Lord on a mount for forty nights, and was granted tablets of divine guidance.

outcome.label: The Outcome
options: My People Crossed the Sea to Safety
A Great Flood Destroyed the Disbelievers
A Tyrant's Fire Became Cool and Peaceful
The Sea Cast Its Captive onto the Shore
The Captive Became the Treasurer of Egypt
outcome.answer: My People Crossed the Sea to Safety

deduction.arabic: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
deduction.verse: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people - (26:10)

scramble.hint: A divine command affirming that admonition and reminders truly benefit the faithful — often cited in the context of dawah and conveying the message.
scramble.verseEn: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
